goal: Export only an explicitly selected product to a NEW GLB file and reload it
preconditions: OUTPUT_GLB is a new explicit absolute path
PRODUCT_NAMES lists authorized mesh/object names; object selection is deliberate
checks: Reload in an isolated scene; verify object/material bounds and intended animation
Verify the real exported asset in its final viewer/engine
limits: export_apply is a choice for this static-product example, not a universal setting for rigged assets
File existence or successful import does not prove visual fidelity
validation: Executable recipe tested via MCP in a fresh isolated session on Blender5.2.1LTS; see knowledge-acceptance.json. Limits remain as documented.
